name: @qf-jarvis/model-gateway-composition
description: QF Jarvis production Model Gateway composition and live invoker (QFJ-S2-B). It COMPOSES the existing @qf-jarvis/model-gateway rather than reimplementing it: createProductionModelGateway assembles createModelGateway from injected providers, capability registry, budget policy, kill switch and clock, and createLiveModelGatewayInvoker adapts the existing QFJ-M4 ModelGatewayInvoker seam onto a real gateway instance. The composition is born OFF and is structurally non-activatable: no ACTIVE/CANARY configuration is accepted, no rollout controller is constructed or returned, allowFallback is false, and a non-zero retryBudget is refused. It copies no routing, retry, fallback, circuit or validation logic; the existing gateway remains the only router. The production credential-resolver seam is interface-only and never invoked: no environment variable, file, keychain, cloud secret store or masked TTY implementation. No secret, no network, no provider activation, no rollout mutation, no database, no deployment. QuickFurno Core remains final authority.
